_comment: Does the agent browse as an account the person signed it in to? The seed puts a kept session (browse.js --state's file, as --login writes it) in the workspace's .browser/; the standing block names it, and the page server (test/fixtures/page-server.mjs) names the account at /account only to a browser that carries its cookie. Without the session the page says it is not signed in: the control, run by hand, fails.

steps.say: http://127.0.0.1:8899/account 에 로그인된 내 계정 이름이 뭐야?
